evidence.scope: Final read-only numerical, interpretation and public-artifact privacy review. No inference, training, repository edits, or mutable report-manifest validation.

interpretation.iemocap_angry: Declines in all three seeds in BOTH validation and test; observed trade-off, no mechanism established.
interpretation.context_cel: Not universally majority: IEMOCAP2025 test 48.428915%; IEMOCAP3407 test 140.329542% because other views worsen. Reports retain these and explain ratios are not attribution.
interpretation.meld_cel: Only seed1937 improves on validation and test. The two other seeds worsen; mean CEL worsens on both splits. No stable cross-dataset CEL benefit.
interpretation.ece_auroc: All three MELD test ECE improve while all three AUROC-Success decrease. IEMOCAP has mixed AUROC behavior; calibration is distinct from correctness ranking.
interpretation.robustness: Average W-F1 gains are small with mixed test-seed signs, all primary descriptive intervals cross zero, n3 exact p cannot establish conventional significance.
interpretation.research_limits: Fixed split/session uncertainty, known IEM1937 and pilot test exposure, prefix smoothing invertibility, GNN-edge ablation scope, first-batch gradient sampling, upstream feature extraction not audited all disclosed.

privacy_checks.limits: Figures being finalized by leader; current SVG text scanned, no visual-content re-analysis or final mutable REPORT_MANIFEST hash race. Safe feature filenames and SHA256 entries are identifiers, not raw features.

evidence.report_completeness: All eight required reports exist. Supplemental CEL per utterance, n2 new-seed sensitivity, actual Adam audits, full-config consistency, near-zero CEL ratio guard and full attempt ledger are now present. No actionable blocker found.
